messages:
rami-partners: NovaWeights asked: can Redwood list them as hosted and allow SI/reseller rehosting? They want a small co-marketing blurb + a provenance badge. Need to scope requirements.

claire-ops: Ops minimums: model card, manifest with artifact sha256s, export attestation, and either a provider-provided quantized artifact or explicit permission to quantize. Also need tokenizer spec for streaming.

nina-legal: License note: current draft disallows redistribution. For resellers we need a reseller addendum (redistribution grant + indemnity + export clause). I can draft a short template if we get their license PDF and list of approved resellers.

ben-eng: Engineering: If they don't allow quantization, we can host fp16 only but must bump price and call out perf limits. Their tokenizer emits multi-byte tokens — will require a tiny SDK shim. Also ask them for a perf attestation (p50/p95 on our ref hw, seq=512).

claire-ops: Packaging requirement for SI bundles: signed manifest (PGP or HSM sig) with artifact list. Example minimal manifest text we need: 
``nmanifest:1
artifacts:
  - weights.tar.gz:sha256=<hex>
  - tokenizer.json:sha256=<hex>
signature:<pgp-or-hsm>
```

rami-partners: Timeline ask from them: hosted listing in 5 weeks, SI bundles in 7. Proposed embargo: partner-only 2026-06-10, public 2026-06-17. Can legal/ops/eng hit this?

nina-legal: We need reseller addendum signed before 06-10 and export attestation cleared by security. I can turn a draft in 48 hours.

ben-eng: If they supply quant artifacts + tokenizer spec by EOW we can validate in week 1. Otherwise timeline slips.

ops-bot: ticket created: partner-onboard/NW-782 (owner: rami-partners)

claire-ops: Action list: 1) Rami request license + SBOM + signed manifest + tokenizer spec from ops@novaweights.ai; 2) Nina draft reseller addendum; 3) Ben build SDK shim and perf bench; 4) Ops validate artifacts when received. Friday check-in.
